description: Implementation of the MemoryStorageGrain class for in-memory persistence in Orleans. Provides methods for reading, writing, and deleting grain state asynchronously, with ETag validation and detailed logging.

classes.name: MemoryStorageGrain
classes.description: An internal partial class implementing a grain storage mechanism using in-memory dictionary with ETag support.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the state associated with a grain store key, returning a typed grain state.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes or updates the grain state for a given key with concurrency control via ETags.

methods.name: DeleteStateAsync
methods.description: Marks the grain state as deleted by setting its value to null, with ETag validation.

methods.name: NewEtag
methods.description: Generates a new unique ETag using GUID.

methods.name: GetETagFromStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the current ETag for a given grain store key.

methods.name: ValidateEtag
methods.description: Validates that the received ETag matches the current ETag, throws exception on mismatch.
